subject: design-technology
title: Iterative Design
welcome_lead: Build to think, think to build — repeat.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: iterative design process and prototyping.

concepts.def: Cyclic process: design, build, test, refine.
Working model used to test ideas.
Minimum Viable Product — smallest version that delivers value.
Observing real users interact with a prototype.
Discover flaws early when changes are cheapest.
Significant change in design direction following testing.

walkthroughs.body_html: Iterative design replaces 'waterfall' linearity with repeated cycles: design → prototype → test → refine. Each loop builds knowledge cheaply before committing to expensive tooling.
Low-fidelity prototypes (cardboard, sketches) test concept. MVPs test market fit. High-fidelity prototypes test manufacture. Each fidelity level suits a different question.
User testing drives iteration. Nielsen suggests 5 users uncover ~85% of usability problems. Observation, think-aloud protocol and post-task interview are standard methods.
